name: sma_crossover_banknifty_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On BANKNIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working directional orders create persistent micro-trends visible as SMA alignment across 3-min, 15-min, and 60-min windows. When SMA(36) > SMA(180) > SMA(720) all align bullishly AND price retouches the fast SMA(36) after a brief pullback, the order flow is sustained at multiple timescales — not just a spike but continuous demand absorption by institutional desks still working their orders. This micro-pullback-to-fast-SMA entry captures the next 30-50 spot point continuation leg while limiting exposure by entering during a retracement rather than chasing breakouts.

indicators.name: sma_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute fast SMA — the trade trigger. Compressed from original 10-min (10 bars × 1 min) to 3 min because at 5s resolution we trade the micro-pullback continuation, not the slow drift. The 3-min window captures the pace at which BANKNIFTY institutional algorithms typically execute partial fills. When price touches and bounces from this level, the algorithm is still accumulating.

indicators.name: sma_180
indicators.purpose: 15-minute mid-trend SMA — context filter. Scaled to match original 29-min (29 × 1min ≈ 30 min, halved because we hold 30-120s not 5-20 min). Confirms the intraday directional regime is in place — institutional flows that create the micro-trend are typically working on a 15-30 min execution horizon.

indicators.name: sma_720
indicators.purpose: 60-minute macro SMA — regime filter. Maps to original 100-min (100 × 1min ≈ 100 min) compressed to 60 min. At 5s bars, this is 720 bars = 1 hour. We need 1 hour of context to confirm BANKNIFTY is in a persistent directional session, not a range-bound day where SMA alignments are noise. This is purely a filter, not a trade trigger.

indicators.name: pullback_to_sma36
indicators.purpose: Entry refinement: require price to be within 0.05% of the 3-min SMA (within ~25 BANKNIFTY points). This avoids chasing breakouts and instead waits for a pullback-to-support entry — better risk/reward than the original's simple alignment trigger. Added because 5s bars give us the resolution to make this distinction.

conditions: close > sma_36 (price above fast SMA, confirming uptrend intact)
abs(close - sma_36) / sma_36 < pullback_threshold (price near fast SMA — pullback touch)
buy_ce.confirmation: All three SMA alignment conditions must be simultaneously true on the current 5s bar

conditions: close < sma_36 (price below fast SMA, confirming downtrend intact)
abs(close - sma_36) / sma_36 < pullback_threshold (price near fast SMA — pullback touch)
buy_pe.confirmation: All three SMA alignment conditions must be simultaneously true on the current 5s bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option premium points (~8 BANKNIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). BANKNIFTY micro-pullbacks to the fast SMA typically retrace 8-15 spot points. If the move exceeds 8 spot points against us, the micro-trend structure is broken — the institutional order has likely completed or reversed. A 4-point option stop respects this boundary while keeping R:R viable.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option premium points (~14 BANKNIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). BANKNIFTY micro-continuation legs from SMA pullback entries typically extend 30-50 spot points; 14 points captures the early portion (first 30-40%) of this move, balancing win rate against hold time. This gives a 1:1.75 R:R ratio. Targeting the full 30-50 pt move would require a 3-4 minute hold, outside our 30-120s window.

filters.vix_filter: none (BANKNIFTY institutional flow-driven; VIX regime less relevant than for NIFTY at this timescale)
filters.time_filter: no trades before 09:20 IST (skip opening noise); no new entries after 15:20 IST
filters.volume_filter: none (5s index data volume is noisy; rely on SMA alignment for quality)
filters.trend_filter: SMA stack alignment is the trend filter — all three SMAs must be ordered

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — multi-timeframe SMA alignment is widely known; edge depends on entry refinement (pullback-to-SMA) which is less crowded than pure alignment strategies

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from original: (1) Lookbacks compressed from 10/29/100 min to 3/15/60 min — we target the 30-120s continuation, not the 5-20 min move, so context windows are proportionally shorter. (2) Added pullback_to_sma36 condition — at 5s resolution we can wait for price to touch the fast SMA rather than entering on any alignment; this improves entry quality and risk/reward. (3) Added bearish (buy_pe) mirror of original bullish-only logic — on BANKNIFTY both bull and bear institutional flows create the same pattern. The stop/target are in option premium points (4/7 pts) vs original's 50-pt spot stop and 0.5% target — calibrated to BANKNIFTY ATM delta ~0.5 and 30-120s typical move magnitudes.
weaknesses: BANKNIFTY SMA alignment breaks down in high-volatility intraday sessions with frequent direction changes (budget day, RBI events)
Pullback entry condition may miss fast trending days where price never touches the SMA — will underperform in strong momentum regimes
720-bar (60-min) SMA requires 1 hour of warmup before first trade — no signals in first hour of session
SMA crossover strategies are crowded; edge depends on the pullback refinement differentiating from naive alignment entries
